# Changelog — `mrz`

All notable changes to the `mrz` crate. The format is based on
[Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/).

`mrz` is versioned independently of the SynthPass workspace it lives in. It is **pre-1.0, so
the minor slot is the breaking slot** — `^0.7` resolves `0.7.x` but never `0.8.0`. Which slot a
change lands in follows from how the type is declared; see `CONTRIBUTING.md`'s "Semver policy"
in the repository root.

**Contributors: do not edit this file in a pull request.** Add a fragment to
[`changelog.d/mrz/`](../../changelog.d/mrz/README.md) instead. Fragments are assembled here at
release time by `scripts/assemble-changelog.sh --scope mrz --write`.

## Before 0.7.1

This file starts at 0.7.1, the version current when the crate got its own changelog.

Earlier releases — 0.4.0 through 0.7.1 — were recorded as prose inside the workspace's
[root `CHANGELOG.md`](../../CHANGELOG.md), because `mrz` had no separate one. That history is
not lost, but it is interleaved with application changes; search the root changelog for
`` `mrz` `` to find it. Notable entries there include 0.6.0 (ICAO-conformant long document
numbers, breaking), 0.6.3 (TD1 name line), 0.7.0 (`find_and_parse` rejects a structurally
implausible reading) and 0.7.1 (widened `CONFUSABLES`).

Nine of those releases — 0.5.1 through 0.7.1 — also shipped without a git tag. See
[`RELEASING.md`](../../RELEASING.md) for how that happened and what now prevents it.
